summary: BTC Digital Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the completion of construction of a 10 MW computing infrastructure project in Georgia, USA, and a strategic transformation into an AI computing infrastructure platform. The press release describes plans to develop an AI computing center in phases, with initial 5MW deployment and potential expansion to 25MW, subject to customer demand and financing. No specific deal terms, prices, or dates are provided. The filing is a routine operational update and strategic plan, not a special situation event.
